===Models=== *[[Ruckus Wireless R750]] - AX3600 Indoor 802.11ax 4x4:4 Wi-Fi AP *[[Ruckus Wireless R730]] - AX6000 Indoor 802.11ax 8x8:8 Wi-Fi AP *[[Ruckus Wireless ZoneFlex R720]] - Dual Band 802.11ac Wave 2 Access Point :(4x4:4 ac, 3x3:3 n, MIMO, BeamFlex, WPA3) • [http://certifications.prod.wi-fi.org/pdf/certificate/public/download?cid=WFA73327 WFA73327] (2019-02-20) *[[Ruckus Wireless ZoneFlex R710]] - Dual Band 802.11ac Wave 2 Access Point :(4x4:4 MIMO, BeamFlex, Dual Ports, 802.3af PoE, US) • B012E4BWXI *[[Ruckus Wireless ZoneFlex R700]] - Dual Band 802.11ac Indoor Access Point :(3x3:3 MIMO, 802.3af PoE, 901-R700-US00) • B00MV93Q2M
==See also== *[[Ruckus Wireless H350]] • Wi-Fi 6 Wall Plate Access Point, Worldwide (901-H350-WW00) *[[Ruckus Wireless R350]] • Wi-Fi 6 (11ax) Dual band Indoor AP 2x2:2 (901-R350-WW02) *[[Ruckus Wireless H550]] • Wi-Fi 6, Wired/Wireless Wall Switch, BeamFlex+, USB port, :1x GbE WAN, 4x GbE LAN ports, PoE in, PoE out (one port) (901-H550-WW00) *[[Ruckus Wireless R550]] • Wi-Fi 6, 2x2:2 (2.4GHz/5GHz) OFDMA, MU-MIMO, BeamFlex+, :Dual ports, 802.3at, onboard BLE/Zigbee (901-R550-WW00) *[[Ruckus Wireless R650]] • Wi-Fi 6, 2x2:2/4x4:4 (2.4/5GHz), OFDMA, MU-MIMO, BeamFlex+, :Dual ports, PoH/uPoE, 802.3at PoE (901-R650-WW00) *[[Ruckus Wireless R750]] • Wi-Fi 6, 4x4:4 (2.4/5GHz), OFDMA, MU-MIMO, BeamFlex+, :Dual ports, 802.3at, onboard BLE/Zigbee (901-R750-WW00) *[[Ruckus Wireless R850]] - Wi-Fi 6, 4x4:4/8x8:8 (2.4/5GHz), OFDMA, MU-MIMO, BeamFlex+, :Dual ports, PoH/uPoE, 802.3at PoE (901-R850-WW00)
